description: Train custom wake word models with openWakeWord. A granular 13-step pipeline with compatibility patches for torchaudio 2.10+, Piper TTS, and speechbrain. Generates tiny ONNX models (~200 KB) for real-time keyword detection — like building your own "Hey Siri" trigger. WSL2/Linux + CUDA required.
